newsitem.title: GERMANY: CONTINENTAL UP 4PCT ON SIX-MONTH RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: CONTINENTAL UP 4PCT ON SIX-MONTH RESULTS.

text.p: Shares in German tyre-maker Continental AG rose more than four percent on Monday after the company reported a 73 percent profit jump for the first six months of the year.
The shares were up two marks at 50.20 marks in bourse dealings at 1045 GMT, while the 30-share DAX index was down 0.6 percent.
The stock had one of the highest turnover volumes of the day.
Continental earlier reported six-month pre-tax profit of 208 million marks, up 73 percent from 120 million in the year-ago period. First-half sales rose to 5.35 billion marks from 5.09 billion.
